estimates.assumptions: 2 large Romano peppers ≈ 300 g total raw weight; finely chopped and drained of juice per instructions (edible portion only).
800 g raw lamb mince (typical 20 % fat ground lamb).
3 tbsp Turkish red pepper paste (biber salçası) ≈ 60 g total.
1 tbsp pul biber (Turkish chili flakes) ≈ 6 g; modest seasoning quantity.
3 tbsp sunflower oil (total in recipe); 2 tbsp mixed into mince + 1 tbsp for brushing before cooking; all oil is included as consumed.
